import time, hashlib, jwt

SELF = 'https://brain.example.com/mcp'
SCOPE = {'search': 'brain:read', 'fetch': 'brain:read',
         'list_sources': 'brain:read', 'who_knows': 'brain:read'}

def accept(token, tool):
    key = jwks.get_signing_key_from_jwt(token).key
    claims = jwt.decode(token, key, algorithms=['RS256'],
                        audience=SELF,  # tricky part: token must be minted for this server
                        options={'require': ['exp', 'aud', 'sub']})
    scopes = set(claims.get('scope', '').split())
    if SCOPE[tool] not in scopes:
        raise Forbidden(f'missing scope {SCOPE[tool]}')
    return Principal(claims['sub'], claims.get('tenant'), claims.get('agent_id'), scopes)

@mcp.tool()
async def search(query: str, sources: list[str] | None = None,
                 limit: int = 20, cursor: str | None = None, ctx=None):
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    p = accept(bearer(ctx), 'search')
    limit = min(limit, 20)
    try:
        res = await asyncio.wait_for(
            core.search(p, query, sources, limit, cursor), 8.0)
        status = 'ok'
        return to_mcp_result(res)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        status = 'timeout'
        raise ToolError({'code': 'timeout', 'message': 'try again', 'retry_after_s': 2})
    finally:
        log_call(p, 'search', hashlib.sha256(query.encode()).hexdigest(),
                 status, int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000))

import base64, hmac, hashlib, json, time

def sign_cursor(pos, qhash, principal, ttl=900):
    body = json.dumps({'p': pos, 'q': qhash, 'u': principal,
                       'x': int(time.time()) + ttl}, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    mac = hmac.new(SECRET, body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(body + mac).decode()

def read_cursor(tok, qhash, principal):
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(tok.encode())
    body, mac = raw[:-32], raw[-32:]
    good = hmac.new(SECRET, body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(mac, good):  # tricky part: constant-time compare
        raise Problem(400, 'bad_cursor')
    c = json.loads(body)
    if c['x'] < time.time() or c['q'] != qhash or c['u'] != principal:
        raise Problem(400, 'cursor_expired_or_foreign')
    return c['p']

@app.post('/v1/search')
async def search(req: SearchReq, p: Principal = Depends(auth),
                 idem: str | None = Header(None, alias='Idempotency-Key')):
    qh = hashlib.sha256(req.query.encode()).hexdigest()
    pos = read_cursor(req.cursor, qh, p.id) if req.cursor else 0
    items, nxt = await core.search(p, req.query, req.sources, min(req.limit, 50), pos)
    return {'items': items,
            'next_cursor': sign_cursor(nxt, qh, p.id) if nxt is not None else None,
            'request_id': new_request_id()}

ll_fmt.code:
from datetime import datetime
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

FIELDS = ('id', 'title', 'uri', 'snippet', 'score', 'source_app',
          'version', 'retrieved_at', 'permission_checked_at')

class Envelope(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    uri: str
    snippet: str = Field(max_length=300)
    score: float
    source_app: str
    version: str
    retrieved_at: datetime
    permission_checked_at: datetime
    acl_stale: bool = False

def cut(text, n=300):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    # tricky part: cut on a word boundary and leave room for the ellipsis
    return text[:n - 1].rsplit(' ', 1)[0].rstrip() + '\u2026'

def to_envelope(hit, now):
    src = {
        'id': hit.doc_id, 'title': hit.title, 'uri': hit.uri,
        'snippet': cut(hit.text_excerpt), 'score': round(hit.fused_score, 4),
        'source_app': hit.source_app, 'version': hit.source_version,
        'retrieved_at': hit.fetched_at, 'permission_checked_at': hit.last_acl_check_at,
    }
    missing = [f for f in FIELDS if src.get(f) in (None, '')]
    if missing:
        raise MissingField(missing)  # a hit without provenance is not served
    env = Envelope(**src)
    env.acl_stale = (now - env.permission_checked_at).total_seconds() > 300
    return env
